title: Bay State Gas Company submits an independent contract for city-gate supply service and for local transportation between Bay State and Peter Whalen owner and manager of business property located at 7 Old South Street, Northampton, Massachusetts.
petitioner: Bay State Gas Company d/b/a Columbia Gas
filings: The Department APPROVES both Contracts. Also, the Department APPROVES the Company's request that the proposed IS Contract be used as a standard offer IS contract. Commissioners participating were: Janet Gail Besser, Chair; Commissioners James Connelly, W. Robert Keating, Paul B. Vasington and Eugene J. Sullivan, Jr.
